name: NoteOut
fullname: Note Out, a gate and a note to the MIDI OUT
summary: A gate and a note out of the G1's MIDI OUT, as the G2's NoteSend: Chan, Vel, Mute, Gate thru.
author: Animatek
about: Sends a MIDI note from the G1's MIDI OUT, after the G2's NoteSend. Feed it a note level and a gate: a rising edge of the gate starts the note and its fall ends it. Chan sets the MIDI channel and Vel the velocity. Mute silences the track: the gate counts as low, so a note held is turned off and no more go out. Gate thru passes the gate on.
The DSP sends no MIDI itself: it leaves a word for the 68k, which reads it in the OS's main loop and queues the note on the MIDI OUT.
usage: Plug a sequencer's note and gate into it to play an outside synth from a patch.
Choose the channel to match the instrument.
notes: The note is the nearest semitone, kept to 0-127, with 0 units as note 64 (an E, the keyboard's Note out).

patch_notes.noteout-lfo.pch: An LFO's square gates the Note Out, which sends notes out of the G1's MIDI OUT.
